stories.title: Trevor Rogers 5yr/$120M — Cubs' First Rotation Signing (Tier 1)

x_posts.label: Post 1
x_posts.text:
Trevor Rogers is a Cub — 5yr/$120M, pending physical. The first confirmed rotation signing of this offseason.

Rogers: 4.03 ERA, 169.2 IP and 157 K in 30 starts for Baltimore in 2026. 2025 ceiling: 1.81 ERA. The rebuild has started. Seven days until the lockout.

#Cubs

x_posts.label: Post 1B

The Cubs gave up their 2nd-round pick for Trevor Rogers, and it was exactly the right call.

Five open starter slots, seven days to the lockout, and a lefty who posted 169.2 IP with a 1.81 ERA ceiling. You can debate whether $120M is worth it. You cannot debate the need.
